title: Export system logs to a file
summary: Collect and save system logs from a specific time period to a file on disk. Useful for sharing logs with support or analyzing them later.

steps.explain: Exports all logs to disk for the specified time period. Requires administrator privileges.

placeholders.name: TIME_PERIOD
placeholders.description: The duration of logs to collect (e.g., 1h, 24h, 7d).

placeholders.name: OUTPUT_FILE
placeholders.description: The path and filename for the log archive (must end in .logarchive).

rollback.explain: Delete the exported log file if it was created by mistake.

warnings: Ensure you have enough disk space for the log archive.
